verdict.rationale: Anthropic's own docs list an official `ant` command-line tool for shell scripting and interactive use, and llms.txt publishes CLI version metadata, so the product does ship an official CLI. The evidence is only brief listings, though, with no detail on what the CLI can do. Missing for 10: documentation of the CLI's commands and features (e.g. which API surfaces it covers, auth, output formats), and independent or hands-on corroboration of using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
